rows.reason: Four real assertions. Lines 35-36 verify the outgoing payload contract of create_run inside the mock transport handler, which is the behaviour the test name promises. Tail assertions 50-51 are decorative (they assert the mock canned response) but the test is not vacuous.

Assert-absence test whose sibling at 155-160 proves the same handler emits the warning on the degraded path, so assertEqual(catalog_warnings(), []) at 173-176 is a meaningful negative rather than a vacuous one. The detector scores per function and cannot see the pairing.

False positive: test_relax_targets_use_configured_defaults verifies the telemetry engine numerical relaxation calculation. Lines 183-186 assert falsifiable bounds (target > 57.0, target <= 60.0) on SUT output captured by a spy collaborator, and line 183 explicitly guards the no-call case. The mock-heavy setup and the private-state writes at 156-157 are why a detector could score this as vacuous, but the assertions are real and falsifiable.

False positive: test_concurrent_apply_proposed_updates_no_double_emit is a real concurrency test. Two threads released together by a threading.Barrier both call the genuine engine.apply_proposed_updates, and the assertions at 131-132 (sum(results) == 1 and call_count == 1) fail deterministically if _apply_lock is removed, which is the mutation the test exists to catch. Mock-construction sites outnumber assertion sites, but nothing asserts a canned value back at itself.

False positive: test_sleep_for_retry_uses_exponential_backoff pins the exponential backoff progression the provider itself computed. slept holds the delay values the SUT passed to time.sleep, observed through a patch that records rather than fabricates, and line 386 asserts the exact [1.0, 2.0] progression; line 385 asserts the retry count. The raw.content assertion at 384 restates the mock transport canned response and is weak, but the backoff arithmetic is real SUT output. Consistent with findings 6 and 7, the identical test against the ollama and openai providers.

False positive: test_llm_gateway_failover_on_5xx constrains real routing behaviour, not merely mock interaction. It asserts BOTH gateway URLs (primary then fallback), the fallback Authorization header, the resulting agent name and call_count == 2. A broken failover path fails these on the URL and header assertions independently of the count. Evidence read at the d9bb793 reconstruction, not at the unreachable pin 9ab774d7; see evidence_deviation on this record.
